reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Anne-Marie Peterson.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Anne-Marie Peterson. Anne-Marie is an equity portfolio manager at Capital Group, a storied investment firm managing 2.5 trillion dollars and getting ready to celebrate its centennial anniversary. Anne-Marie is a seasoned investor, approaching three decades in the industry, with nearly 20 of those years being with Capital.

key_points.text: She has become an expert in retail and restaurants and shares her proven strategies in those sectors over her career.
We discuss her people-first approach, simplicity as criteria for investment, and the idea that the best retailers are cults.
Please enjoy this great discussion with Anne-Marie Peterson.
